## Use Fantasque Sans Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Fantasque Sans Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Fantasque Sans Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true
}

Copy

## About the Fantasque Sans Mono coding font

A programming font with a handwritten feel. Fantasque Sans Mono is a free monospace coding font with programming ligatures.

Fantasque Sans Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Fantasque Sans Mono FAQ

### Is Fantasque Sans Mono free?

Yes. Fantasque Sans Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Fantasque Sans Mono support ligatures?

Yes. Fantasque Sans Mono ships programming ligatures. Use the ligature switch above the specimen, or set "editor.fontLigatures": true in VS Code.

### Where can I get Fantasque Sans Mono?

Fantasque Sans Mono is available from GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
